column1: # Readings of the 1882 print (Amaraviveka, ed. Thatte under Kielhorn, Nirṇaya Sāgara, Bombay;
# archive.org 20231127_20231127_1402) adopted over the Wikisource e-text, and the print's
# structure where the e-text's lines do not show it. Applied by parse.py (text) and
#   K.V   e-text n   op   old   new   leaf
# Text ops (parse.py):  line = replace the whole half-verse with `new`;  r = replace `old` by `new`;
#   join = append this line to the one before;  drop = not in the print;  add = a half-verse the
#   e-text lacks, `new`, inserted after n (numbered n.1, n.2 …);  move = the print has line n after line `new`;  mark = a group marker (इति …न्ताः) after n (empty: none there).
# Structure ops (number.py):  ks = a kṣepaka line;  main = not a kṣepaka;  end = closes a śloka;
#   open = does not close one;  nip = in the e-text but not in the print (shown apart, like a kṣepaka);
#   v = a real variant, kept as the e-text has it (listed only).

column5: साहसं तु दमो दण्डः साम सान्त्वमथो समौ
